correctness.rationale: A matched edge in the cubic prism covers at most six vertices; selecting ceiling(n/3) rungs with cyclic gaps at most three hits that bound. The local alphabet records each physical edge once, compatibility checks shared endpoints, and each cyclic transition checks domination for the central column. For n=3 the repeated window positions identify the same columns and do not introduce an extra matching or constraint. The trace fixes the column origin and counts labelled edge sets, not cyclic orbits or endpoint sets. Independent replay (python3 /workspace/branches/reproduction/prism.py) constructs options by physical incidence, verifies 49 states, 147 arcs and an integer potential, certifies the two zero-cost SCC cycles of lengths 3 and 6, and proves the other three rational trace identities exactly by multiplying the series by the determinant or its square and testing all numerator coefficients up to the adjugate degree bounds 48 or 96. The log-determinant expansion to reduced costs 0,1,2 then yields the all-n minimum coefficients. In the cost-2 case the single-mark term contributes 2-(-1)^k after division by n; the two-mark term extracts half of [w^(k-1)](15-20w+11w²-2w³)/(1-w)^4, giving the stated cubic factor. Independent recursion by smallest available vertex agrees with complete transfer histograms at every n=3..10 (108691 matchings), including c4=42 and c7=147. Finite enumerations alone are not the infinite proof.
